scientific_purpose: Five-seed source-registered original native TAC language optimizer comparison at learning rates chosen prospectively by independent real-source TAOTUNE004 three-trial equal-tuning procedure. All 25 real publisher FIT models have exactly same 100521 trainable/deployed parameters, per-seed original source/token budgets, frozen two-doc report cohort, checkpoints and replay. Descriptive internal paired uncertainty only; not certified architectural superiority.

real_world_source.name: Original licensed PSF CPython 3.13.0 14-document FIT publisher corpus and source-registered UTF8 supplement

causal_protocol: For each seed1701..1705 freeze original full160-step source sampler/hash from TAO002; fit first64 original genuine publisher batches B4 context256 with no DEV read and identical per-seed init/schedule across five optimizers. Before ANY fit, independently verify every saved original TAOTUNE004 checkpoint + Git-origin source and score receipt, then choose per-mode LR exclusively by fixed min-NLL/tie-lowest-LR selection on previously exposed controlflow.rst and index.rst 512-target tune cohort. For TAO, only ffn_up.weight uses selected orthogonal LR; all remaining weights keep AdamW LR0.001. Pure AdamW control uses selected global LR. No report source during fit. After each of 25 original model/optimizer/RNG complete Git commitments, separate clean-checkout runner restores original bytes and scores first256 genuine next-byte targets on each original previously exposed introduction.rst and venv.rst DEV doc, 512 labels per arm per seed. No TEST or new independent cohort.
checkpoint_policy: For each seed/mode preserve full trained MODEL.pt including model/optimizer/Py/NumPy/Torch RNG, SHA, actual source/plan hash, clip/no-future-prefix poison, trained cost and loss trace. Keep all 25 original frozen files and failures in Git before separate score. Exact SHA+model/optimizer moment step reload and bounded numeric logits with immutable bitwise status per arm, independent replay and postfit registration SHA/100521p gate. No checkpoint overwrite or promotion.

budget.execution: standard free GitHub Actions CPU with at most five concurrent seed fits, no paid GPU

training_source_frozen_by_seed: research/mathematical-engineering/tao002/ORIGINAL_PREFIT_RECEIPT.json, original first64 of five frozen160 schedules
selection_rule: each mode's minimum NLL on frozen tuning documents; tie lower LR; no selection using report docs

prior_dev_exposure_disclosure: Both tuning and report DEV documents appeared in prior TAO003 heldout evaluation; report set is disjoint ONLY within this new study, not statistically blind or independently qualified.

metrics.primary: per-mode 5-seed arithmetic mean report DEV NLL
secondary: paired seed NLL difference versus AdamW
sample sd and 95% t interval descriptive only

resource_rule: Match same model, actual trained/deployed 100521 count and identical per-seed FIT tokens, steps, sample sequence, wall clock reported not gated; optimizer FLOPs intrinsically differ, no invalid 1% total FLOP parity claim; descriptive optimizer efficiency only.
